candidates.description: This vector represents common German verbs in various inflected forms.
These tokens represent common directional and locational spatial prepositions and particles.
This feature vector represents common German separable verb prefixes and adverbial particles.
This feature vector activates strongly on the German letter 'ä' and words or subwords containing it.
These tokens represent common German verbs frequently used to express states, actions, or relational concepts in descriptive sentences.
This feature vector represents German indefinite pronouns, articles, and negation words related to quantity and existence.
These tokens represent German modal verbs and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, permission, or future/conditional tense.
Common German adverbial and adjectival modifiers expressing degree, manner, or state.
This vector represents the domain of sports, games, and athletic competitions.
This feature vector represents German conjunctive and adverbial connectors used to indicate logical progression, contrast, or addition within a sentence.
